```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample DataFrame
df_pd = pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [0.5, 0.75, 0.9]
})

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_pd)

# Convert dtypes
df_converted = df.with_columns([
    nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),
    nw.col("score").cast(nw.Float32)
])

print(df_converted)
```
